title: Asset-card OPEN button size is not enforced by any test
detail: AC5 requires 'every interactive target ... enforced by tests' and 'all modal buttons ≥120'. The asset-card OPEN button (a modal button, 170×130) has no size assertion; tests cover only _make_big_button and the three named HUD buttons.
recommended_fix: In _check_touch_target_sizes_scene, build a non-damaged asset card via _make_asset_card and assert its action button's combined minimum size ≥120 in both dimensions.

title: NEW GAME button stays sub-floor (110px) through the proxy's settle-delay window
evidence:
_open_popup hides the proxy when the card opens (street.gd:549-550):
	_refresh_dominant_button()
	_hide_touch_proxies()
_show_leaderboard delays the wrap behind a bounded settle loop (street.gd:840-850):
	var last_rect := Rect2()
	for _i in range(300):
		await get_tree().process_frame
		...
	if is_instance_valid(reset) and _reset_proxy != null:
		_reset_proxy.wrap(reset, FinLitTouchTargets.Role.SECONDARY)
The visible button itself stays 110px tall (street.tscn:198):
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 110)
detail: AC4 says the button 'gets a ≥120px hit area'. From _open_popup (proxy hidden) until the 300-frame settle loop converges (≈5s worst case, ~0.3s typical) the proxy is hidden and the button remains 110px — below the floor.
recommended_fix: Pre-place the proxy at the reset button's nominal card position before awaiting layout, then reposition once the rect converges; or document the transient animation gap as an explicit AC4 carve-out.
